subtitles.en: Lizanne Saunders joins us right now. She's chief investment strategist at Charles Schwab.
subtitles.zh: Lizanne Saunders现在加入我们。她是Charles Schwab的首席**策略师。

subtitles.en: She joins us on a day where yes, technically the Dow, the S&P, the Russell, the NASDAQ, pretty much every industry is going to be 10% or below. They're all time high, barring some major reversal in
subtitles.zh: 她加入我们的这一天，是的，从技术上讲，道指、标普、罗素、纳斯达克，几乎每个行业都将下跌10%或以下。它们都处于历史高位，除非在未来15分钟内出现重大逆转，Lizanne。

subtitles.en: the next 15 minutes, Lizanne. Is this sort of the warning that you've been giving us on this show, the idea that all this calm we've seen at the index level, that maybe that was kind of hiding some
subtitles.zh: 这是你一直在节目中给我们的警告吗？即我们在指数层面看到的平静，也许掩盖了表面下的一些裂痕？

subtitles.en: of the cracks underneath? Well, there's no question that that was the case because even coming into today, the NASDAQ as an example, hadn't had more than a 13% drawdown at the index level.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，毫无疑问情况就是如此，因为即使到今天，以纳斯达克为例，指数层面的回撤从未超过13%。

subtitles.en: We may get past that and sorry, I have a little bit of a cold. Okay. But the average member within the NASDAQ, just not including today, not on an intraday basis, its average maximum drawdown at the
subtitles.zh: 我们可能会超过那个水平，抱歉，我有点感冒。好吧。但纳斯达克内的平均成员，不包括今天，不是盘中，其平均最大回撤在平均成员层面是负51%。

subtitles.en: average member level is negative 51%. Now, that may ultimately or eventually be good news in that there's been a lot of damage done under the surface, providing maybe an opportunity for diversifiers
subtitles.zh: 现在，这最终可能是好消息，因为表面下已经造成了大量损害，也许为多元化市场参与者提供了寻找其他领域的机会，但我们可能还没到那一步。

subtitles.en: to come look for other areas, but we may not quite be there yet. Well, I mean, it's kind of interesting.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这有点有趣。

subtitles.en: We kicked off the show with the last year of the longest and he kind of talked about this idea of buying into this dip and he made a lot of cases as to why primarily focused on macro conditions.
subtitles.zh: 我们以去年最长的一次开场，他谈到了逢低买入的想法，并提出了很多理由，主要关注宏观条件。

clip_research.source_claim: The average member within the NASDAQ, excluding today, has an average maximum drawdown of negative 51%, while the index itself had not had more than a 13% drawdown — meaning calm at the index level hid widespread losses under the surface.
clip_research.public_baseline: Schwab's official page confirms Sonders is Chief Investment Strategist at the Schwab Center for Financial Research, a regular market commentator; no public snippet verifies the specific 51% vs 13% drawdown figures.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The gap between index-level drawdown (~13%) and average constituent drawdown (~51%) is a striking dispersion claim, but it is not independently corroborated by the provided public snippets.

evidence.fact: Average NASDAQ constituent max drawdown ~-51% vs index drawdown ~13%.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
